text: An update to the Terms of Reference for Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Human Resources Committee is presented for Board consideration. The proposed change amends the composition of the Committee, removing the specific requirement for participation by a Councillor Board member.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Amended Section 4 a. Composition of the Human Resources Committee of the Terms of Reference of the Human Resource Committee so that it now reads as follows: "The Human Resources Committee shall be comprised of three TAF Board members, including the TAF Board Chair."
